name: Paper
summary: Warm off-white paper, near-black ink, and one terracotta accent. A serif display face over a system sans.

sans.license: Operating system font. Nothing is downloaded or redistributed.

mono.license: Operating system font. Nothing is downloaded or redistributed.

do: Use the terracotta accent for one primary action per view.
Set headings in Fraunces at 600 and keep body copy in the system sans.
Separate sections with the line color instead of shadows.
dont: Don't put muted text on the surface color at sizes under 14px; use ink instead.
Don't add a second accent color. Use ink or muted for everything else.
